title: Alice and Farah: site expansion planning
text:
<meeting id="7b1e9c2a-4f3d-4e8a-9b61-2d5c8f0a3e17" title="Alice and Farah: site expansion planning" date="Oct 7, 2026 8:30 AM PDT" url="https://notes.granola.ai/d/7b1e9c2a-4f3d-4e8a-9b61-2d5c8f0a3e17">
  <known_participants>
  Alice Chen (note creator) from Acme Robotics <alice@example.com>
  Farah Haddad from Acme Robotics <farah@example.com>
  </known_participants>
  
  <summary>
# Second warehouse site

- The shortlist is down to one site: Tucson, Arizona. Internal codename: Project Bluebird.
- Plan: move 12 AMR-7 units from the north warehouse to Bluebird in Q1 2027.
- Alice presents it to the board on 14 Oct; the lease decision is due 30 Oct.
- Confidential: do not discuss Bluebird outside leadership until after the board meeting.

# Fleet readiness

- Farah wants the canary rollout live before any units move, so Bluebird starts on the new release process.
</summary>
</meeting>

title: Weekly fleet sync
text:

  </known_participants>
  
  <summary>
# Release process

- Canary ring confirmed for Monday 12 Oct (decided 6 Oct, ACME-240). Farah owns it; the runbook update is still open.

# Gripper calibration

- Dana: the fix for ACME-210 (encoder offset written to flash) is in review and ships in 4.8.1.
- Bob: night shift still re-homes grippers by hand every morning. Eli filed ACME-231 for it; it is waiting for triage.

# Warehouse

- Aisle 12 cycle count tonight, robots geofenced 22:00-02:00 (ACME-238).

# Action items

- Farah: update the Firmware Release Runbook before Monday.
- Eli: triage ACME-231 by Thursday.
</summary>
</meeting>
